result.summary: The application interface contains a major loading issue in the 'Popular right now' section where a generic loading spinner is persistently displayed over content, and a minor layout issue where the restaurant name is clipped.

issues.description: A persistent, semi-transparent loading spinner overlay is visible on top of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' featured card, obscuring the image and potential user content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading state completes correctly or times out; remove the overlay if the content beneath has finished loading.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated at the end due to limited container space.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text styling or container width to ensure the full name is visible, or implement an ellipsis correctly if truncation is intended.
